overview.text: Elleson says the $40 trillion national debt is driving inflation. He lists fiscal responsibility as a top legislative priority. He opposes changing the law to allow all Americans to buy into Medicare. In a 2018 questionnaire, he disagreed that government is responsible for ensuring everyone has health insurance. He has suggested exploring health savings accounts for younger people and expanding local clinics to lower healthcare costs.
